items.html: *Behold, it was explained above how ZA, when he is a son of nine years and one day, is already fit for union, for he then ascends immediately, at the beginning of the tenth year, in the secret of Mayin Nukvin, and then the Mochin begin to enter him. But with regard to his being called a complete man, he is not called so until he is a son of thirteen years and one day, for then four more years have passed over him, and four Mochin entered him, which are Keter, Hochma, Bina and Daat; and then he is called a completely perfect man, as is known, for there is no man less than thirteen years and one day.
